headline: Widespread buying in the Old Continent. In Milan, Moncler, Amplifon and the banking risiko. Overseas, Warsh
summary: The main Eurozone markets moved into positive territory, and the FTSE MIB followed the same bullish trend. Moncler, Amplifon and bank stocks were highlighted in Milan.
why: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark index of the Milan Stock Exchange, covering Italy's largest listed companies.

impacts.name: FTSE MIB
impacts.why: Broad buying lifted the Milan benchmark index into positive territory.
